Diversion Case Manager – Special Project - Job Posting 1566
The Diversion Case Manager provides direct support for youth experiencing, or who are at-risk of homelessness to secure safe housing alternatives to emergency shelter that is appropriate to their circumstances including acquiring or to maintain existing housing. The Diversion Case Manager coordinates case management and support planning with youth and the team. ... Learn More
Youth and Family Therapist - Job Posting 1570
This position is responsible for delivering exceptional client service related to individual psychotherapy, family and group therapy for individuals aged 12-24 and their families. This includes capturing a bio/psycho/social assessments, administrating, scoring and delivering results of standardized assessments, treatment planning, case management, psycho-education, advocacy, clinical consultations, individual/family/group psychotherapy, discharge planning, preparation of reports for clients presenting with mental health, emotional or behavioural issues. ... Learn More
Youth and Family Therapist – Live-In Treatment - Job Posting 1569
This position is responsible for providing high quality individual, family and group psychotherapy services for YouthLink’s Live-In Treatment (LIT) Home. Constance House is open to youth aged 14–17 who identify as female, including those who are cis-gendered, gender-fluid, non-binary, or transitioning. The program is for young people who would benefit from intensive live-in treatment looking to address their mental health and emotional wellness.... Learn More
